==Basic language==
[[Algebraic structure]]s are defined primarily as [[set (mathematics)|sets]] with ''operations''. 
*[[Algebraic structure]]
**[[Subobject]]s: [[subgroup]], [[subring]], [[subalgebra]], [[submodule]] etc.
*[[Binary operation]]
**[[Closure (mathematics)|Closure]] of an operation
**[[Associative property]]
**[[Distributive property]]
**[[Commutative property]]
*[[Unary operator]]
**[[Additive inverse]], [[multiplicative inverse]], [[inverse element]]
***[[Identity element]]
***[[Cancellation property]]
*[[Finitary operation]]
**[[Arity]]

Structure preserving maps called ''homomorphisms'' are vital in the study of algebraic objects.
*[[Homomorphism]]s
**[[kernel (algebra)|Kernel]]s and [[cokernel]]s
**[[image (mathematics)|Image]] and [[coimage]]
**[[Epimorphism]]s and [[monomorphism]]s
***[[Isomorphism]]s
****[[Isomorphism theorem]]s

There are several basic ways to combine algebraic objects of the same type to produce a third object of the same type. These constructions are used throughout algebra.
*[[Direct sum]]
**[[Direct limit]]
*[[Direct product]]
**[[Inverse limit]]
*Quotient objects: [[quotient group]], [[quotient ring]], [[quotient module]] etc.
*[[Tensor product]]

Advanced concepts:
*[[Category theory]]
**[[Category of groups]]
***[[Category of abelian groups]]
**[[Category of rings]]
**[[Category of modules]] (over a fixed ring)
***[[Morita equivalence]], [[Morita equivalence#Further directions|Morita duality]]
**[[Category of vector spaces]]
*[[Homological algebra]]
**[[Filtration (algebra)]]
**[[Exact sequence]]
**[[Functor]]
*[[Zorn's lemma]]
